battle.name: 宋滅南漢之戰
battle.brief: 開寶三年（970）九月，宋太祖以潘美為賀州道行營兵馬都部署，尹崇珂副之，率潭、朗、道諸州兵南下討南漢。半年之間連取富、賀、昭、桂、連、韶諸州，開寶四年二月破馬逕木柵，辛未劉鋹素服出降於白田。卡面的秦弩在此役是決定性遠程兵器：南漢以弩手居高守城，宋軍則盡索軍中勁弩射散象陣。

kit.name: 秦弩
kit.history: 弩機把拉力存起來，射速遠勝拉弓。守城的一方靠它把攻城的人壓在牆外。

countries: 這場戰爭是北宋開國時期針對南漢的一場大規模軍事行動，發生在開寶三年至開寶四年（970至971），戰場橫跨嶺南五嶺道，東起韶州、連州，西至賀州、昭州、桂州，最後收束於廣州白田。北宋一方是剛平定後蜀與南唐的中原王朝，由太祖趙匡胤直接下詔，於開寶三年九月任命潭州防禦使潘美為賀州道行營兵馬都部署，掌全軍節制；朗州團練使尹崇珂副之，與潘美同掌行營；道州刺史王繼勳任行營馬軍都監，統率騎兵；另設隨軍轉運使王明掌管糧秣輜重，並從潭、朗、道、岳、袁等湖南諸州調發兵員與丁夫，編為行營部隊。南漢一方是割據嶺南的劉氏政權，名義上雖向宋稱臣，實則由主劉鋹自行稱帝，國都在廣州。其軍政體系在戰前已嚴重空虛：先主在位時誅戮宗室與眾將，良將邵廷琄因讒言被賜死，掌兵的只剩幾名宦官，宗室翦滅殆盡，兵備長期空疏。開寶三年南唐主李煜遣使勸降，劉鋹囚使者、答書無禮，宋廷據此議伐；南漢直到宋軍已入賀州才倉促應戰，指派伍彥柔、潘崇徹、李承渥、郭崇岳、植廷曉等人分線抵禦，卻彼此不相統屬，調度混亂，最終在廣州陷落前崩潰。
countriesEn: This campaign was a large-scale military operation launched by the early Northern Song against Southern Han, fought between the third and fourth years of the Kaibao era (970 to 971) across the Five Ridges corridor of Lingnan, stretching from Shaozhou and Lianzhou in the east to Hezhou, Zhaozhou and Guizhou in the west, and closing at Baitan outside Guangzhou. On the Song side stood a central plain dynasty that had just destroyed Later Shu and Later Tang. Emperor Taizu Zhao Kuangyin issued the order himself, and in the ninth month of the third Kaibao year (970) he appointed Pan Mei, then defender of Tanzhou, as bingma du bushu, the commander-in-chief of the Hezhou Circuit field camp; Yin Chongke, drill commander of Langzhou, served as his deputy and shared control of the camp; Wang Jixun, governor of Daozhou, was made commander of the camp's cavalry; and a separate transport commissioner, Wang Ming, was attached to the force to handle grain and baggage. Soldiers and labour were conscripted from Tanzhou, Langzhou, Daozhou, Yuezhou, Yuanzhou and the other Hunan prefectures and formed into the field camp. On the other side stood Liu family's Southern Han, which ruled Lingnan nominally as a Song vassal but in practice as an independent empire under its own emperor Liu Chang, with its capital at Guangzhou. Its military system had been hollowed out well before the war: the earlier ruler had executed his own kinsmen and most of his generals, and the able commander Shao Tingxuan was put to death on slander after he had drilled troops at Guankou and gathered refugees; only a few eunuchs were left holding troops, and the royal clan had been almost wiped out, so the army had no real preparation. In 970 the Later Tang ruler Li Yu sent an envoy urging Liu Chang to submit. Liu Chang imprisoned the envoy and replied insultingly, and the Song court used that letter as its justification for war. Southern Han only reacted once the Song army was already inside Hezhou, appointing Wu Yanrou, Pan Chongche, Li Chengwo, Guo Chongyue and Zhi Tingxiao to hold separate lines with no common command, and the structure collapsed before Guangzhou could be relieved.
people: 推動開戰的是宋太祖趙匡胤與南唐主李煜的一封勸降書。開寶三年，李煜派給事中龔慎儀持自撰書信赴廣州，勸劉鋹幡然改圖、奉表稱臣，以免宋軍水陸並進；劉鋹讀後大怒，將龔慎儀囚禁，並以極不尊敬的語氣回書，李煜把來書直接轉呈宋太祖，宋廷由此下定出兵之決心。行營主帥潘美字仲詢，出身行伍，乾德元年自泰州團練使調任潭州防禦使，多次擊退南漢對桂陽、江華的寇掠，並於乾德二年攻下郴州，是南線最熟悉嶺北地形的將領；他在本役兼任賀州道行營兵馬都部署，負責全盤作戰。副將尹崇珂出身河北鄴縣，作為行營副手參與攻賀、昭、桂、連諸役；王繼勳原為道州刺史，掌行營馬軍，馬逕之役前反覆出擊的騎兵挑戰即出其部。隨軍轉運使王明在賀州之役中主張速攻，率百餘名護送輜重之卒與數千丁夫畚鍬填壕，直抵城下，逼得守軍開門。南漢方面的關鍵人物首推主劉鋹：他誅宗室、寵宦官、好女色、斂財急賦，把持軍政的能臣或殺或不用，臨陣只能仰賴宦官與外戚；其弟禎王劉保興在馬逕戰敗後逃回廣州，宦官樂范更挾千餘衛兵盜走載有金寶妃嬪的船十餘艘，使南漢主連海路退走的念頭也被斷絕。南漢將領中，伍彥柔以目疾推脫、久不得用，出兵救賀州後中伏被擒斬首；潘崇徹被推為統帥卻稱病不出，後受命領眾三萬屯賀江又只顧擁兵自保，最終在宋軍未至城下即出降；都統李承渥領十餘萬屯韶州蓬華峰下，以象陣壯軍威，卻被弩箭射散而僅以身免；招討使郭崇岳據馬逕列柵拒守，史書評其無謀勇、惟日禱於鬼神；大將植廷曉力主出戰，陣亡於河畔。
peopleEn: The push for war came from a letter of persuasion written by the Later Tang ruler Li Yu and handed to Emperor Taizu Zhao Kuangyin. In 970 Li Yu sent the palace official Gong Shenyi to Guangzhou with a letter of his own composition, urging Liu Chang to change his ways and present a memorial of submission, so that the Song army would not advance by land and water at once. Liu Chang was furious: he imprisoned Gong Shenyi and answered with a reply of the utmost discourtesy, and Li Yu forwarded the letter to the Song court, which then settled on the decision to campaign. The field commander Pan Mei, courtesy name Zhongxun, came from a military family; in the first year of the Qiándé era he was moved from drill commander of Taizhou to defender of Tanzhou, drove off several Southern Han incursions into Guiyang and Jianghua, and took Chenzhou in the second year, which made him the Song officer who knew the northern edge of the Five Ridges best. He served in this war as bingma du bushu of the Hezhou Circuit camp and directed the whole operation. His deputy Yin Chongke, a native of Ye in Hebei, took part in the attacks on Hezhou, Zhaozhou, Guizhou and Lianzhou. Wang Jixun, formerly governor of Daozhou, commanded the camp's cavalry, and the repeated mounted provocations before the palisade at Majing came from his men. The transport commissioner Wang Ming argued at Hezhou that the attack had to be hurried, and led a hundred men escorting baggage together with several thousand labourers, baskets and shovels in hand, to fill the moat right up to the city gate, which forced the garrison to open the doors. On the Southern Han side the central figure was the ruler Liu Chang. He slaughtered his kinsmen, favoured eunuchs, indulged in women and women of the household, and strained the people with urgent exactions; capable men who held the army were either killed or left unused, and at the moment of crisis he could rely only on eunuchs and on his own relatives by marriage. His brother, Prince Zhen Liu Baoxing, fled back to Guangzhou after the defeat at Majing, and the eunuch Le Fan, with more than a thousand of his guards, stole away a dozen or more ships loaded with treasure and the imperial harem, which cut off even the ruler's plan to escape by sea. Among the Southern Han generals, Wu Yanrou had long been passed over and sheltered behind an excuse of eye trouble; he marched to relieve Hezhou, fell into the ambush, was captured and beheaded. Pan Chongche was named commander but claimed illness, and when he was later given command of thirty thousand men at the He River he thought only of preserving his own force, finally surrendering before the Song army even reached his city. The commander-in-chief Li Chengwo brought more than a hundred thousand men to Penghua Peak outside Shaozhou and arrayed war elephants to bolster the army's morale, but a volley of crossbow bolts scattered them and he escaped with his life alone. The recruiting commissioner Guo Chongyue held the line of wooden palisades at Majing, and the histories record that he had neither strategy nor courage, spending his days praying to ghosts and spirits. The general Zhi Tingxiao argued for giving battle, fought to the death by the river, and fell there.
kits: 卡面這件秦弩是戰國時代秦國的弩機形制：木弩臂以張弦的蹶（腳蹬）拉開，弦扣在機牙上，靠懸機與望山一放即發，射手只需扣動機括，不必再拉臂，因此一名弩手即可在城頭或塹壕後獨立操縱，射速雖慢於弓箭齊射，卻能讓防守方以人力換取更遠的射程與更穩的指向。此役最能說明弩價值的兩個場面都在嶺南：一是南鄉夜渡的伏擊，伍彥柔挾彈登岸，隨行的弩手在登岸瞬間被宋軍奇兵衝散，全軍十之七八死於亂軍；二是開寶三年十月韶州之戰，南漢都統李承渥領十餘萬屯蓬華峰下，把每象載十數人、盡執兵杖的象陣排在軍前壯威，潘美盡索軍中勁弩射之，大象受驚奔突，反過來踐踏自己的隊列，南漢精兵一夕潰散，宋軍乘勢取韶州並擒其刺史辛延渥。攻城一方同樣靠弩：賀州被圍時，城頭弩手居高臨下壓住宋軍，宋軍不便展開，只能靠王明所率丁夫填壕至城門下；賀州、昭州、桂州、連州、韶州一線的城守，依賴的正是弩手與城牆的高度。野戰中，弩與弓箭、刀矛配合：宋軍步隊以弩矢覆蓋通道與柵縫，再以長槍、直刀近身；騎兵用弓箭與長槍作戰；守軍以拒馬、壕溝、壘土構成障礙，並在南漢主塹東壕的命令下挖掘塹壕。器械方面，兩軍都靠舟船沿賀江、桂江、西江輸送糧秣與兵員，轉運使王明所部即管隨軍輜重；南漢曾備船十餘艘載金寶妃嬪欲浮海出走，北宋亦以北取廣州、吳越自泉州浮海兩種進軍方案威懾南漢。
kitsEn: The crossbow on the card is a Qin-state piece of the Warring States period. The wooden bow arm is drawn with a stirrup-style treadle, the string is caught on the release lever, and the shot is loosed by the trigger and the sighting device; the archer has only to work the mechanism and need not pull the arm again. A single crossbowman can therefore operate the weapon on a wall or behind a ditch, and although its rate of fire is slower than a volley of arrows, it lets the defender trade manpower for greater range and steadier aim. The two moments in this campaign that best show the value of the crossbow both lie in Lingnan. First, the night crossing at Nanxiang: Wu Yanrou came ashore with crossbowmen, and the Song surprise attack struck them in the instant they set foot on the bank, seven or eight tenths of his command dying in the rout. Second, the battle of Shaozhou in the tenth month of the third Kaibao year: the Southern Han commander-in-chief Li Chengwo held more than a hundred thousand men below Penghua Peak, and put his war elephants at the head of the line to hearten the army, each animal carrying a dozen or more men armed with weapons. Pan Mei gathered every strong crossbow in the army and fired; the elephants bolted in fright, trampled their own formations, and the Han elite broke up in a single night, after which the Song took Shaozhou and captured its governor Xin Yanwo. The besiegers relied on the crossbow as well. When Hezhou was surrounded, the crossbowmen on the wall held the Song army down from above and gave them no room to deploy, so the Song could only send Wang Ming's labourers to fill the moat up to the gate. The defence of Hezhou, Zhaozhou, Guizhou, Lianzhou and Shaozhou in turn rested on exactly the combination of crossbowmen and wall height. In the field the crossbow worked together with bows, spears and sabres: Song foot soldiers covered the approaches and the gaps in the palisade with crossbow bolts and then closed with long spears and straight blades, cavalry fought with bows and lances, and the defenders used cheval-de-frise, ditches and earth banks, digging a trench on the ruler's own order to hold the eastern approach. On the equipment side both sides relied on boats to move grain and men along the He, Gui and Xi rivers, the transport commissioner's section managing the baggage; the Southern Han prepared a dozen or more ships loaded with treasure and the imperial harem in the hope of a sea escape, while the Song relied on the double threat of advancing on Guangzhou overland or of a fleet sailing from Quan-zhou in Wu-Yue.
tactics: 北宋的作戰方式在此役中呈現出典型的先取點、再壓城形態。出師之後，宋軍先取富州，再以主力直逼賀州；當賀州援兵將到時，潘美退二十里，於南鄉岸邊埋下奇兵，等伍彥柔乘船夜泊、拂曉登岸、據胡床指揮之際突然發動，一戰殞其十之七八。轉運使王明進言援兵將至、當急擊之，諸將猶豫之際，他以百餘護送輜重之卒帶數千丁夫畚鍬填壕，直抵城門下，賀州遂開門。取賀州後，潘美故意放話要順流趨廣州，誘使南漢把潘崇徹的三萬人調到賀江屯守，宋軍卻徑趨昭州，昭州刺史田行稠與桂州刺史李承珪望風而逃，兩州不戰而下；十一月取連州，南漢主仍誤判宋軍取地為止。宋軍一路不攻城而取城，省下的時間用於推進。韶州面對的是李承渥的象陣，潘美不與其正面纏鬥，盡索全軍勁弩射象，令其驚潰，反踩本軍；乘亂取韶州，擒辛延渥、鄒文遠。開寶四年正月再取英州、雄州，迫潘崇徹出降。宋軍主力抵瀧頭時，山水險惡、疑有伏兵，潘美挾南漢使者疾行過險，進至柵口、馬逕，屯兵雙女山，居高俯瞰郭崇岳的木柵，並屢遣游騎挑戰，逼其離柵；植廷曉自請率前鋒沿河布陣迎戰，宋軍濟水擊破，植廷曉力戰而死，郭崇岳退回柵內。宋軍再以火攻收束：分遣丁夫各持二炬，間道逼近木柵，夜半萬炬俱發，會天大風，煙塵蔽空，南漢兵大敗，郭崇岳死於亂軍，劉保興逃回廣州。守方則完全以守城待援為主，築壕、列柵、倚城頭弩手，屢請和不成，最後由龔澄樞、李托、薛崇譽等人縱火焚府庫宮殿，企圖以空城迫宋軍退兵，不成，劉鋹素服出降於白田。
tacticsEn: The Song method in this campaign took the familiar shape of seizing strongpoints first and then pressing on the cities. After setting out, the army took Fuzhou and then drove straight at Hezhou. When word came that relief was coming for Hezhou, Pan Mei withdrew twenty li and hid picked troops along the bank at Nanxiang; when Wu Yanrou's boats anchored there in the night, landed at first light and sat on a folding stool to direct his men, the ambush erupted and seven or eight tenths of the Han force were killed. When the transport commissioner Wang Ming argued that the relief army was near and the assault had to be hurried, and the other generals hesitated, he took a hundred men escorting baggage and several thousand labourers with baskets and shovels and filled the moat up to the gate, and Hezhou opened its doors. After taking Hezhou, Pan Mei deliberately spread the word that he would ride the stream down to Guangzhou, which induced Southern Han to move Pan Chongche's thirty thousand men to the He River, while the Song went straight for Zhaozhou; the governor of Zhaozhou, Tian Xingchou, and the governor of Guizhou, Li Chenggui, fled at the first sign and both prefectures fell without a fight. Lianzhou fell in the eleventh month, and the Southern Han ruler still believed the Song would stop there. So much of the advance was won without assault that the saved time could be spent on movement. At Shaozhou the obstacle was Li Chengwo's elephants, and Pan Mei refused to fight the battle out in the open: he gathered every strong crossbow and shot at the animals until they panicked and trampled their own men, then took Shaozhou in the confusion, capturing Xin Yanwo and Zou Wenyuan. In the first month of the fourth Kaibao year the Song took Ying and Xiong, and Pan Chongche surrendered. When the main body reached Longtou, the mountains and streams were dangerous and ambushes suspected, so Pan Mei took the Han envoy with him and hurried through the defiles, advancing to Zhaikou and Majing, where he camped on the Twin Women Mountain overlooking Guo Chongyue's wooden palisade and sent out light horse again and again to provoke, forcing the defenders to leave their works. Zhi Tingxiao asked to bring the vanguard forward and deploy along the river to meet the attack; the Song crossed the water and broke him, Zhi Tingxiao fighting to the death and Guo Chongyue falling back inside his palisade. The Song then closed with fire: labourers were dispatched with two torches each, made their way by concealed paths to the palisade, and at night ten thousand torches went up at once; a great wind rose, smoke and dust filled the air, the Southern Han army broke, Guo Chongyue died in the rout and Liu Baoxing fled back to Guangzhou. The defence was based wholly on holding cities and waiting for relief, with trenches dug, palisades raised and crossbowmen on the walls; repeated requests for negotiation failed, and finally Gong Chengshu, Li Tuo and Xue Chongyu set fire to the treasury and the palace, hoping an empty city would drive the Song away. It did not work, and Liu Chang came out in plain white garments to surrender at Baitan.
data: 有根據可寫的數字大致如下。時間線：開寶三年九月（970）宋軍出師，十月破南漢開建寨，殺數千人、擒其將靳暉，同月取昭州、桂州；十一月取連州；開寶四年（971）正月取英州、雄州，潘崇徹降；二月丁卯朔南漢遣弟劉保興率兵來拒，庚午馬逕野戰，辛未宋軍至白田劉鋹出降。雙方兵力：南漢一方，韶州之役李承渥領兵十餘萬，馬逕之役郭崇岳與植廷曉統眾六萬屯馬逕列柵，潘崇徹受命領眾三萬屯賀江；綜合諸史所載，南漢可調集之兵至少在十六萬以上，而宋軍兵力史無明載。南鄉伏擊中伍彥柔部死者十七八，即十之七八全軍陣亡。賀州攻城時投入填壕的護送輜重之卒百餘人、丁夫數千。開建寨一戰宋軍殺南漢兵數千人。火攻時分遣丁夫各持二炬，夜間萬炬俱發。占領後的收編數字最為明確：得州六十、縣二百一十四、戶十七萬二百六十三。路程方面，軍隊自潭州南下，經賀、昭、桂、連、韶諸州至廣州白田，縱貫嶺北並借西江水道轉運，全程近千里；南漢主曾以船十餘艘載金寶妃嬪擬浮海出走，說明廣州一帶已有可供撤退的海路。
dataEn: The figures that can be supported run as follows. On the chronology: the Song army set out in the ninth month of the third Kaibao year (970); in the tenth month it broke the Southern Han camp at Kaijianzhai, killing several thousand men and taking the general Jin Hui captive, and in the same month took Zhaozhou and Guizhou; Lianzhou fell in the eleventh month; in the first month of the fourth Kaibao year (971) Ying and Xiong fell and Pan Chongche surrendered; on the first day of the second month the Southern Han sent the ruler's brother Liu Baoxing with troops to resist, the field battle at Majing was fought on the seventh, and on the eighth the Song army reached Baitan and Liu Chang surrendered. On strengths: on the Southern Han side Li Chengwo led more than a hundred thousand men to Shaozhou, Guo Chongyue and Zhi Tingxiao commanded sixty thousand at Majing behind their palisade, and Pan Chongche was given thirty thousand to hold the He River; taking the records together, Southern Han could bring at least something over a hundred and sixty thousand men into the field, while the Song numbers are nowhere recorded. At the Nanxiang ambush Wu Yanrou lost seven or eight tenths of his command, in the source phrase 死者十七八. At Hezhou the filling of the moat used a hundred men escorting baggage and several thousand labourers. The storming of Kaijianzhai cost Southern Han several thousand dead. In the fire attack the Song sent out labourers two torches each, and ten thousand torches flared at night. The most certain figures are those of the conquest itself: sixty prefectures, two hundred and fourteen counties, and one hundred and seventy thousand two hundred and sixty-three households. On distance: the army marched south from Tanzhou through Hezhou, Zhaozhou, Guizhou, Lianzhou and Shaozhou to Baitan at Guangzhou, running the length of the northern ridges and using the western river for transport, a route close to a thousand li. The ruler's plan to load a dozen or more ships with treasure and the harem and sail out by sea also shows that a usable escape route by water already existed off Guangzhou.
cause: 開戰的起因有三層。最直接的一層是外交上的失禮：開寶三年，南唐主李煜派給事中龔慎儀持書勸南漢主劉鋹奉表稱臣，信中直言宋軍若至水陸並進、百道俱進，甚至會用吳越舟師自泉州浮海直抵廣州；劉鋹得書大怒，囚龔慎儀，回書詞不遜，李煜將來書直呈宋太祖，宋廷由此決定出兵。第二層是南漢本身的失政與邊釁：劉鋹誅宗室、戮良將，邵廷琄整軍練兵、屯洸口、招輯亡叛，本已使國人少安，卻因讒言被賜死，掌兵只剩宦官數輩，備戰近乎空白；同時南漢屢次出兵寇掠湖南的桂陽、江華，與宋的潭州防禦使潘美直接對峙，宋乾德元年、二年已兩度交鋒，郴州易宋。更深的一層是宋室的戰略時機：乾德三年後蜀滅亡，南唐亦在開寶四年入於宋，北宋連續用兵已把主要威脅消除，東南的南漢成了唯一仍以獨立之身拒絕稱臣的割據政權，太祖選擇在此時一舉解決嶺南，以消除南唐覆亡後留下的變數，也為了打通由廣州通向海上交通與西南邊地的道路。對南漢而言，劉鋹的算盤則是拖延：他以為宋軍取了昭、桂、連、賀四州便會止步，卻低估了宋廷一路南下的決心，也未料到自己的內部會在四個月內連失大將與重鎮。
causeEn: The outbreak of the war had three layers of cause. The most immediate was a diplomatic discourtesy. In 970 the Later Tang ruler Li Yu sent the palace official Gong Shenyi with a letter urging the Southern Han ruler Liu Chang to present a memorial of submission; the letter stated plainly that if the Song army came it would advance by land and water at once, along a hundred roads, and might even use the Wu-Yue fleet to sail from Quan-zhou to Guangzhou. Liu Chang was furious, imprisoned Gong Shenyi and replied in insolent terms; Li Yu handed the letter to the Song emperor, and the court then decided on war. The second layer was Southern Han's own misgovernment and border friction: Liu Chang butchered his kinsmen and his generals, and Shao Tingxuan, who had drilled troops, garrisoned Guankou and gathered refugees, thereby giving the country some peace, was put to death on a slanderous charge; only a few eunuchs were left to hold troops and preparations were close to nothing. At the same time Southern Han repeatedly raided Guiyang and Jianghua in Hunan, confronting the Song defender of Tanzhou, Pan Mei, with two engagements in the first and second years of the Qiándé era, and Chenzhou changed hands. The deeper layer is the strategic moment chosen by the Song court: with Later Shu destroyed in the third year of Qiándé and Later Tang about to surrender in the fourth year of Kaibao, the Song had removed its main rivals, and Southern Han had become the only remaining separatist state in the southeast that still refused to acknowledge submission. Taizu chose that moment to settle Lingnan in one stroke, eliminating the loose end left by the fall of Later Tang and opening the road from Guangzhou to maritime traffic and the southwestern frontier. Southern Han, for its part, was playing for time: Liu Chang believed that once the Song had taken Zhaozhou, Guizhou, Lianzhou and Hezhou it would stop there, and he underestimated both the Song court's resolve to press south and the way his own command would lose generals and cities within four months.
impact: 這場戰爭的直接影響是南漢的徹底覆亡與廣南的統一。開寶四年二月庚寅，宋廷大宴群臣，宣布收得州六十、縣二百一十四、戶十七萬二百六十三，五嶺南北自此盡歸北宋版圖，廣州從割據政權的都城變成中原王朝的邊州，此後再沒有出現獨立的嶺南割據者。治政層面的改變同樣明顯：宋廷下詔赦免廣南各州縣，蠲除南漢舊日一切無名賦斂，並放免那些被買為奴婢、轉佣牟利的人口，廢除舊政中害民的部分，又令偽署官仍舊留任，使地方行政不致中斷。潘美在受降之後又南下討平土豪周思瓊聚眾負海為亂，嶺表自此安寧，廣南的商旅與農耕恢復常態。就戰略與制度而言，這一役確立了北宋由湖南經五嶺道直取廣州這條南征通道，後來宋廷對西南的經營與對海上貿易的管理都沿著這條線展開；潘美本人也因平南之功升為湖南防禦使，隨後成為滅南唐的主將之一。對兵器史而言，韶州一役的盡索軍中勁弩射之是一次有明確文字記載的弩兵運用實錄：以弩的集中射擊瓦解對方的衝鋒戰力，說明弩在十世紀的嶺南戰場上仍舊是決定攻城與野戰勝負的骨幹力量。
impactEn: The immediate effect of the war was the total destruction of Southern Han and the unification of Guangnan. On the day marked geng-yin in the second month of the fourth Kaibao year the Song court banqueted its ministers and announced the acquisition of sixty prefectures, two hundred and fourteen counties and one hundred and seventy thousand two hundred and sixty-three households; the Five Ridges, north and south, from that moment belonged entirely to the Northern Song, and Guangzhou ceased to be the capital of a separatist state and became a frontier prefecture of a central plain dynasty, after which no independent Lingnan regime ever arose again. The changes in administration were equally marked: the court decreed general amnesty throughout the prefectures and counties of Guangnan, cancelled all the unnamed levies and exactions of the Southern Han years, freed those who had been bought as slaves and let out for hire, abolished the harmful parts of the old government, and left the officials of the former regime in their posts so that local administration would not collapse. After the surrender Pan Mei went on to put down the pirate bands of the local notable Zhou Siqiong, and Lingnan was quiet thereafter, with trade and cultivation in Guangnan returning to normal. In strategic and institutional terms the campaign established the Song route of advance from Hunan through the Five Ridges to Guangzhou, along which later Song administration of the southwest and control of maritime trade were both organised; Pan Mei himself was made defender of Hunan for his part in the southern conquest and was one of the commanders who took Later Tang two years later. For the history of arms, the record of gathering every strong crossbow in the army and shooting at the elephants at Shaozhou is a documented case of crossbow troops in action: concentrated crossbow fire broke the momentum of a charging formation, showing that in the tenth century the crossbow remained the backbone of both siege and field combat in Lingnan.
result: 結果是南漢政權的終結與嶺南的入宋。開寶四年二月辛未，宋軍抵達廣州白田，劉鋹素服出降，潘美承制解除了他的武裝，將他押解京師，削去帝號而授以官職；南漢的六萬大軍在馬逕一戰中崩解，府庫與宮殿在內亂中被宦官龔澄樞、李托、薛崇譽縱火焚毀一空，廣州城遂不戰而屬宋。此役過程中最具決定性的三個環節：一是南鄉伏擊全殲南漢援兵伍彥柔部，切斷賀州外援；二是韶州以勁弩射散象陣，消滅南漢最後一支成建制精兵；三是馬逕木柵前夜以火攻配合弩箭破柵，擊殺招討使郭崇岳，逼得南漢主無路可走。宋軍自出師至受降歷時約半年，未經強攻的州縣甚多，昭州、桂州、連州皆因守吏望風而逃，賀州則靠填壕而克，真正硬仗只有南鄉、韶州與馬逕三處。從全局看，這一役是北宋統一戰爭中南漢一環的最後拼圖：後蜀亡於乾德三年，南唐降於開寶四年，南漢亡於開寶四年，北方與東南的割據局面在開寶九年吳越納土後徹底結束，五代十國的分裂局面自此為北宋一統所取代。
resultEn: The outcome was the end of the Southern Han state and the incorporation of Lingnan into the Song. On the day xin-wei in the second month of the fourth Kaibao year the Song army reached Baitan at Guangzhou; Liu Chang came out in plain white garments and surrendered, and Pan Mei, acting under imperial authority, released him from his arms and sent him under escort to the capital, where his imperial title was stripped and he was given an office instead. The sixty thousand Han troops collapsed at Majing; the treasury and the palace were burned to the ground by the eunuchs Gong Chengshu, Li Tuo and Xue Chongyu in a frenzy of destruction, and the city of Guangzhou therefore passed to the Song without a further assault. Three moments in the campaign were decisive. First, the ambush at Nanxiang destroyed Wu Yanrou's relief army and cut Hezhou off from help. Second, the strong crossbows at Shaozhou broke up the elephant formation and wiped out the last fully organised Han elite. Third, the fire attack of the night before the palisade at Majing, with crossbow bolts, opened the works, killed the recruiting commissioner Guo Chongyue and left the Southern Han ruler with nowhere to turn. From the start of the campaign to the surrender about half a year passed, and many prefectures fell without a serious assault: Zhaozhou, Guizhou and Lianzhou were abandoned by their governors at the first tidings, and Hezhou was taken by filling the moat. Only Nanxiang, Shaozhou and Majing were hard-fought. In the wider picture this war was the last piece of the Northern Song's unification: Later Shu had fallen in the third year of Qiándé, Later Tang surrendered in the fourth year of Kaibao and Southern Han perished in that same year, and after Wu-Yue handed over its territory in the ninth year of Kaibao the separatist regimes of the north and the southeast were completely swept away, the division of the Five Dynasties and Ten Kingdoms giving way to a single Northern Song.
